question: As per area, India is the _______ largest country in the world.
solution:
The correct answer is __seventh__.

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• India:

 
 
• It is the seventh-largest country in the world.
 
• Russia, Canada, the United States, China, Brazil, Australia are the top six largest countries respectively.
 
• It occupies 2.4 per cent of the total land area of the world.
 
• Indian population is 17.7% of the total world population.
 
• The name 'India’ is derived from the Indus river.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India is the world’s oldest, largest civilization.
 
• It has the largest postal system.
 
• India is the second-largest English speaking country in the world.
 
• India has the world’s largest Hindu population.
